DT_BuildObjectDescText.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_PRF_ResourceBreedingFac: Assign one male and one female parent and supply cake. Automatically breeds, incubates (+100% speed) and butchers offspring; materials drop in front. Power: 500/s, 1000/s while incubating. Pauses without power and resumes when restored. Eggs and offspring cannot be retrieved. Consumed cake is not refunded; unused cake can be recovered.
